summary: Both author-selected genes increased in Kcnb1-null mice relative to WT. Lepr had a published log2 fold change of +1.14 and a registered value of +1.485. Figure S4 showed a measured increase for Jak2, whose registered value was +0.903. The single numerical pair falls below the 30-pair concordance minimum. The proposal passed validation. [Paper](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11556505/) · [Figure S4](https://pmc-oa-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/PMC11556505.2/FSB2-38-e70111-s001.pdf)
openIssues: The paper and all six GEO samples identify bulk hypothalamus. The registered arcuate-nucleus label lacks dissection support.
The complete author DESeq2 table was unavailable. Dryad blocked access to its Figure 2 archive, so its contents remain unknown.
The paper highlights Lepr as a discovery. Its registered BH FDR was 0.05228. The exact author-adjusted P value and the cause of the inference difference remain unresolved.
